DORA Stage 8.2 persistence dependency notices

This distribution adds the following Apache-2.0 components to the product
release dependency graph. Exact versions and publisher POM/artifact identities
are recorded in the Stage 8.2 dependency inventory:
- androidx.annotation:annotation-experimental:1.5.0
- androidx.room:room-common-jvm:2.8.4
- androidx.room:room-common:2.8.4
- androidx.room:room-runtime-android:2.8.4
- androidx.room:room-runtime:2.8.4
- androidx.sqlite:sqlite-android:2.6.2
- androidx.sqlite:sqlite-framework-android:2.6.2
- androidx.sqlite:sqlite-framework:2.6.2
- androidx.sqlite:sqlite:2.6.2
- com.google.code.gson:gson:2.13.2
- com.google.crypto.tink:tink-android:1.23.0
- com.google.errorprone:error_prone_annotations:2.41.0

Apache-2.0.txt retains the complete upstream Apache License, Version 2.0.
AndroidX-Apache-2.0.txt retains the exact license text embedded by the AndroidX
artifacts. The original AndroidX embedded texts are byte-identical to this copy.

Tink Android 1.23.0 also embeds a shaded protobuf-java 4.33.6 runtime.
Protobuf-BSD-3-Clause.txt retains its upstream copyright, license and disclaimer.
This embedded component is distinct from the Maven resolution graph.

The SQLCipher composite and its native constituents, modifications and licenses
are described by the separate third_party/sqlcipher/NOTICE.txt and accompanying
license files. No jsr305 dependency is admitted in the product release graph.
